prospective_sample_start: first eligible game whose T-120 research lock occurs after this contract is merged to main
pre_contract_2026_games: audit-only; excluded from candidate fitting and promotion evidence
core_estimand: On games where a later challenger would switch the frozen F-ST winner, does the challenger win more switches than it loses?

player_state: official timestamped status only after source qualification
role-weighted shock only after model authorization
schedule_context: local kickoff/body-clock offset where reproducibly derivable

interpretation_rules.principle: A switch should require evidence from more than one information channel. Historical football disagreement is retained as one channel; contemporaneous market/news/context evidence supplies orthogonal corroboration.

prospective_diagnostics: raw later-market winner accuracy at each horizon
results stratified descriptively by reputation, player-news, market-move, and travel/rest flags without post-hoc promotion
candidate_creation_rule: This monitor may reveal a candidate hypothesis, but no subgroup or threshold becomes a model from this same evaluation sample. A future switch rule requires a new candidate ID, frozen coefficients/logic, and fresh prospective evaluation start or genuinely prior training data.
